en: A sepia-toned postcard image depicting an old European street scene. Prominently featured is an ornate baroque building with a dome and statues, likely a historic church or religious building. The street has several people walking and there are old-style streetlamps. The background shows more domed architecture. The word 'Dubrovnik.' is printed at the top left, and a small number '724' appears at the bottom left.
